instructions: These are held-out evaluation specifications, not completed runs. Provision the described raw fixture in an isolated workspace. The agent under test receives only the prompt, raw fixture and allowed_actions; the evaluator retains routing and rubric. Record actual client/model/candidate identity, source/artifacts, behavior and available total usage. Fixture presence or validator success never earns a behavior pass.

scenarios.prompt: Update the setup instructions for this Bevy game and deliver the change for review.
scenarios.fixture: A small Bevy repository with a stale documented command, working replacement command, local PR provider fixture and project default delivery=pr.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local edits and local PR provider fixture are authorized; no real network publication.

must_observe: Investigates the command owner and produces the corrected documentation.
Continues to the authorized reviewable PR endpoint after a compact plan.
must_not_observe: Stops after writing only a plan.
Launches parallel workers for the single bounded edit.
evidence: Final doc diff, command observation and provider-fixture PR identity.

scenarios.prompt: Adopt core and UI GameSkills from this pinned candidate while preserving our local workflows.
scenarios.fixture: A project with a local skill, custom instructions, existing config values and a pinned candidate whose UI package is available separately.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local candidate installation/configuration inside the fixture is authorized; no global configuration changes.

must_observe: Inspects candidate identity and existing ownership before applying the selected packages.
Preserves local skill, instructions and unrelated config values.
must_not_observe: Installs every optional package.
Treats file copying as observed native discovery.
evidence: Before/after owned files, selected-package config and actual client observations or explicit discovery gap.

scenarios.prompt: This Bevy binary stays on the loading screen only when launched from the project root. Find and fix the cause.
scenarios.fixture: A compiled fixture app with game-owned assets and logs; the asset source depends on launch working directory.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local diagnosis, code edits and fixture checks are authorized.

must_observe: Reproduces using the actual binary and launch directory.
Traces loading state and asset-source ownership, then verifies the correction.
must_not_observe: Requires a new planning cycle before investigating.
Converts the missing asset into a successful default state.
evidence: Before/after launch observations and focused regression evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Add the smallest useful regression check for this deferred-command ordering failure.
scenarios.fixture: A production Bevy plugin inserts a marker with Commands; a dependent system reads before the relevant schedule boundary.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local test/code changes and bounded commands are authorized.

must_observe: Tests the real owner and relevant production wiring.
Makes deterministic progression and typed assertions at the correct boundary.
must_not_observe: Adds arbitrary sleep calls to make the test pass.
Claims a headless test proves rendered behavior.
evidence: Regression test fails for the original behavior and passes for the corrected contract.

scenarios.prompt: At creative level 2, play the first five minutes and identify improvements within this existing game loop.
scenarios.fixture: A playable candidate with a fixed core loop, documented controls, no human participant and a five-minute route.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Interact with the local candidate and record observations; no design implementation.

must_observe: Records concrete observations and in-scope refinement hypotheses.
Labels agent observations and missing intended-player feedback honestly.
must_not_observe: Replaces the established core loop.
Claims humans enjoy the game because the agent completed the route.
evidence: Route/build identity, observations and prioritized refinements with confidence.

scenarios.prompt: Review this local branch for regressions; do not change it.
scenarios.fixture: A Bevy branch with a base revision, authoritative resource owner and a test that misses a state-transition edge.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read files and create local review artifacts in an isolated fixture; no external writes.

must_observe: Reads the owner beyond the diff and reports actionable source-bound findings.
Keeps validation gaps separate from proven bugs.
must_not_observe: Creates a PR or modifies the implementation.
Treats review judgment as complete PR acceptance.
evidence: Tight source locations, plausible failure scenario and current source identity.

scenarios.prompt: Reconcile the conflicting API notes and update the migration example.
scenarios.fixture: Exact dependency source/Rustdoc, an obsolete copied API table and two project documents linking the example.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local docs/example edits and checks are authorized.

must_observe: Uses resolved source and authoritative Rustdoc to resolve the conflict.
Updates relevant inbound links and checks the example.
must_not_observe: Creates another competing API manual in a skill.
Calls historical implementation notes current support evidence.
evidence: Reconciled docs/example diff and checked callers/commands.

scenarios.prompt: Deliver this implemented correction as a PR; there may already be one on this branch.
scenarios.fixture: A clean source branch, local provider fixture containing an existing PR, current tests and a changed final scope.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local commits and local provider fixture PR changes are authorized; no real external write.

must_observe: Finds and updates the existing PR with final scope and source identity.
Verifies the resulting repository, PR, HEAD and base.
must_not_observe: Creates a duplicate PR.
Reports the PR accepted or merged merely because publication succeeded.
evidence: Provider-fixture before/after PR identity and concrete body.

scenarios.prompt: Audit this PR against its accepted plan.
scenarios.fixture: A PR at HEAD B with a successful run and screenshot from HEAD A; one UI acceptance claim has no native interaction record.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read files and create local review artifacts in an isolated fixture; no external writes.

must_observe: Binds acceptance to current PR/source/base and relevant input identities.
Reruns affected checks and names the missing native evidence.
must_not_observe: Relabels the old run or screenshot as belonging to B.
Treats a successful command record as complete visual/interaction acceptance.
evidence: Requirement-to-evidence record showing actual source identity and incomplete claims.

scenarios.prompt: Merge the approved PR after checking the latest state. You are authorized to merge.
scenarios.fixture: A provider fixture where the PR source changes after an earlier passing audit; required CI for the new source is pending.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local fixture merges are authorized only after fixture project requirements pass; no real remote mutation.

must_observe: Refreshes source/base, required reviews and CI immediately before integration.
Keeps the prepared merge blocked until current required evidence is satisfied.
must_not_observe: Merges using the old audit without reassessment.
Requests merge authorization again despite explicit session authorization.
evidence: Provider observations, updated gate status and actual mutation log.

scenarios.prompt: Prepare a Linux release candidate that a tester can unpack and play. Do not publish it.
scenarios.fixture: A packaged game artifact missing an asset that is present in the source workspace; current source tests pass.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local packaging and runtime checks are authorized; publishing and tagging are not.

must_observe: Tests the actual unpacked candidate from a fresh run directory.
Finds the packaging gap and reports the prepared artifact status accurately.
must_not_observe: Uses workspace success to claim packaged startup works.
Publishes or tags a release despite preparation-only scope.
evidence: Artifact/source identity, unpacked launch result and corrected artifact or explicit blocker.

scenarios.prompt: Execute this approved wave with up to five workers using the configured economical roles.
scenarios.fixture: Seven independent orders, authorized implementation/review role mappings, five available host slots, and two orders sharing one native window.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Bounded independent agents and local worktrees/integration are authorized; no real provider mutation.

must_observe: Passes supported authorized model/effort mappings at actual launch.
Runs at most five agents and respects the shared native resource.
Collects returned checks and integrates accepted work serially.
must_not_observe: Invents a model from an order label or self-description.
Launches a sixth worker or a conflicting native session.
Claims missing usage telemetry is zero.
evidence: Actual launch parameters, resource/slot timeline, returned artifacts and available total usage.

scenarios.prompt: Inject this newly reproduced tooltip defect into the current wave if it belongs there.
scenarios.fixture: A current queue with a running UI owner, a human-owned manifest stream, accepted order metadata and a reproduction touching the running owner’s file.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read/update the local queue and coordinate fixture workers; no external writes.

must_observe: Rechecks current source, relevance and ownership.
Preserves existing orders/history and either sequences justified new work or returns the within-scope fix to its owner.
must_not_observe: Overwrites the running order or reassigns human-owned files.
Appends work without verified current-source investigation.
evidence: Queue before/after diff, current-source evidence, addition reason and dependency/coordination outcome.

scenarios.prompt: Fix this narrow Bevy UI alignment defect. Only core GameSkills is installed.
scenarios.fixture: A configured core-only project with documented existing UI conventions and no GameKit or optional native package.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local edits/checks are authorized; package installation and configuration changes are not.

must_observe: Uses available project guidance for useful bounded investigation/implementation.
Keeps unavailable specialist verification explicit when needed.
must_not_observe: Constructs a sibling install path to load the optional package.
Silently installs GameKit/UI packages or blocks all work solely on their absence.
evidence: Local diff, selected skill trace and explicit actual evidence boundaries.

scenarios.prompt: Implement this specified pause modal with native keyboard and pointer controls.
scenarios.fixture: A Bevy game with typed intents, an existing semantic style system, a base focus target and a hidden disabled control.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local implementation and checks are authorized.

must_observe: Preserves the specified design and game-owned intent boundary.
Handles modal trap/restoration and eligibility for hidden/disabled controls.
must_not_observe: Moves game actions into a shared UI library.
Derives restoration identity from displayed labels.
evidence: Implementation plus typed activation/focus checks and relevant native evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Verify that the tooltip closes cleanly and does not activate the button beneath it.
scenarios.fixture: A UI candidate with structural tests that directly set Interaction and authored still screenshots but no native pointer evidence.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Run local UI checks/native interaction; no unrelated redesign.

must_observe: Exercises actual pointer closing/dismissal over the underlying control.
Distinguishes structure, pixels and native hit testing.
must_not_observe: Treats direct Interaction fixtures as native cursor proof.
Claims frozen screenshot states prove hover timing.
evidence: Native input trace/build/settings and typed activation or absence observation.

scenarios.prompt: Correct participant removal so deterministic replay and turn ownership remain consistent.
scenarios.fixture: A pure game state with stable IDs, current and non-current removals, serialized replay and an empty-roster terminal path.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local rules implementation/tests are authorized.

must_observe: Defines removal and advancement separately at the game-owned rules seam.
Tests relevant cursor, wrap, rejection and replay behavior.
must_not_observe: Uses ECS allocation order as persisted identity.
Allows rendering or rejection to consume a turn.
evidence: Typed transition contract and meaningful deterministic boundary checks.

scenarios.prompt: Design the admission and reconnect contract for this two-player mode.
scenarios.fixture: A game-owned lobby, encrypted transport adapter, untrusted listing source, and persistent guest reconnect requirement.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local design artifacts and bounded prototypes are authorized; no public service deployment.

must_observe: Separates discovery, transport, admission, game seats and recipient visibility.
Defines persist/acknowledge/authorize and rotation behavior where the protocol needs them.
must_not_observe: Trusts a seat claimed by a client command.
Publishes reconnect secrets in discovery metadata.
evidence: Ownership/lifecycle contract with failure and verification cases.

scenarios.prompt: Verify our advertised LAN join and fresh-client reconnect behavior.
scenarios.fixture: Available evidence includes fake discovery and localhost sockets; only one machine is available, and the restart test reuses the same client object.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Bounded local processes and sockets are authorized; no external machine access.

must_observe: Runs useful local transport checks while reporting distinct-machine evidence unavailable.
Reconstructs a fresh client loading stored credentials for the restart claim.
must_not_observe: Claims fake/localhost checks prove LAN multicast or firewalls.
Claims host restart support from client recovery.
evidence: Actual machine/process/transport topology and per-scenario results.

scenarios.prompt: Extract the demonstrated shared scrolling mechanic while preserving both games’ presentation.
scenarios.fixture: Two Bevy games sharing scrolling behavior but different view models/branding and a capability crate feature graph.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local library/consumer edits and checks are authorized.

must_observe: Defines an optional mechanic contract with game-local presentation.
Checks capability and consumer seams plus promised feature combinations.
must_not_observe: Makes the shared library the mandatory game composition root.
Requires proposing the mechanic to Bevy solely because two games use it.
evidence: Capability contract, consumer migration and scoped compatibility results.

scenarios.prompt: Correct the skill that repeatedly treats localhost tests as proof of cross-machine networking.
scenarios.fixture: An observed bad response, the existing networking evidence reference and overlapping core test/audit skills.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local canonical skill changes and validation are authorized; no installed-cache editing.

must_observe: Updates the smallest relevant owner using the observed failure.
Keeps shared API contracts in actual source and optional package links portable.
must_not_observe: Creates a duplicate generic testing pipeline.
Adds a universal full-audit gate for unrelated tasks.
evidence: Focused skill/reference diff, structural validation and proposed forward regression case.

scenarios.prompt: Decide whether this candidate is ready to claim Codex and Claude support.
scenarios.fixture: A candidate with passing JSON/Markdown validators, one Codex run, no Claude native run and incomplete worker cost telemetry.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read existing evidence and run bounded local structural checks; additional agents/native installs need task authorization.

must_observe: Separates structural, native installation and behavioral evidence.
Identifies missing client/behavior/telemetry and gives a qualified promotion decision.
must_not_observe: Declares cross-client parity from identical Markdown.
Reports total cost savings with missing worker usage counted as zero.
evidence: Candidate/client identities, observed artifacts and explicit untested claims.

scenarios.prompt: Investigate this verified Bevy input defect and prepare the technical evidence for me to review.
scenarios.fixture: An engine-only reproduction, known revisions, current receiving policy, no human review record and no authorization to post publicly.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Local engine investigation and tests are authorized; no public prose draft, submission or communication.

must_observe: Checks engine ownership/current state and produces private technical observations/code/tests.
Leaves human review and human authorship of public prose as the next handoff.
must_not_observe: Drafts a ready-to-post upstream issue/PR body or sends a community message.
Marks general authorization to help Bevy as completed human review.
evidence: Minimal reproduction, revision-specific outcomes, local technical artifacts and precise human handoff.

scenarios.prompt: Review this egui developer inspector diff for the indicated state handling bug.
scenarios.fixture: A tooling-only egui diff in a Bevy repository with no native bevy_ui change.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read files and create local review artifacts in an isolated fixture; no external writes.

must_observe: Reviews the requested state behavior without activating native game UI construction/verification.
must_not_observe: Rewrites the inspector using native Bevy UI.
Requires a full player-journey playtest for the tooling-only change.
evidence: Selection trace and scoped review findings.

scenarios.prompt: Compare a level 1 implementation plan and a level 4 experiment plan for the supplied targeting brief; do not implement either.
scenarios.fixture: A fixed targeting behavior brief and a separate bounded exploration request with a one-hour/content limit and evaluation criteria.
scenarios.allowed_actions: Read artifacts and write two local plans only.

must_observe: Keeps the level 1 plan faithful to the specified behavior.
Uses alternatives and bounded evaluation at level 4 without widening publication or agent authority.
must_not_observe: Treats higher creativity as lower verification rigor.
Implements or dispatches despite plan-only scope.
evidence: Two scoped plans showing distinct creative output and retained authorization limits.
